sources.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models / CLIP (Radford et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Caption-prediction pre-training on 400M web pairs learns transferable representations addressable by natural language: zero-shot transfer to 30+ datasets incl. OCR, video action recognition, geolocalization, fine-grained classification; matches supervised ResNet-50 on ImageNet with zero of its 1.28M labels; code+weights released.
claims.context: Full-paper abstract (199KB body consumed at abstract+sections+limits depth); numbers paper-reported.

claims.text: Break reading: fixed predetermined-category supervision replaced by image-text supervision with language as the concept-reference interface — the addressability transition (TS-003 angle; conditioning reuse by reference to TS-002).
claims.context: Paper's own fixed-vs-natural-language framing in abstract/introduction.

limitations.text: Original-paper zero-shot limits: weak fine-grained classification (car models, flower species, aircraft variants), counting (CLEVRCounts), near-random novel systematic tasks (KITTI distance); out-of-distribution brittleness (MNIST 88%, below a pixel baseline); ~1000x compute estimated to reach overall SOTA (infeasible on current hardware).

targets.finding: Complete CLIP paper body consumed via arXiv HTML (199KB text): fixed-vs-natural-language framing, 400M-pair recipe, 30+ dataset transfer results, code/weights release, Limitations section verified.

targets.target: Targeted authority correction (CLIP BoW misattribution removed)
targets.finding: Bound primary paper re-verified read-only 2026-10-06 (arXiv HTML of the already-bound locator; no new source). The 2021 original paper contains no bag-of-words/compositionality limitation claim (BoW appears only for the Joulin et al. baseline method and the caption-prediction ablation in §2.3/Fig.2); the prior target is superseded and the limitation replaced with §6/§3.1.5 scope.
